Dear Mr Shepherd,

I refer to your below email, received 24 July 2026. I sincerely apologise on the delay taken to action this
request.

In regard to point 1 of your request - please see attached an amended list of documents.

Through the ongoing disclosure obligations of parties to the appeal, the Regulator has disclosed any new
documents relevant to the appeal to you throughout the appeal process and will continue to do so should
we receive any further documentation.

In regard to point 2 of your request - please see attached copies of the Notice of Non-Party Disclosure
(NNPD) issued by the Regulator in relation to this matter.

The Regulator confirms that it has already disclosed the documentation received from these NNPD's on 14
July 2025, 22 July 2025 and 11 June 2026.

Kind regards,

Renee Matheson
